items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive vs DET Sunday as details finalized. Houston among teams with interest.
items.why: Trade talks finalized; team informed player morning of game.
items.implication: Zero Week 5 production; opens targets for other AZ WRs.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson primary beneficiary for routes/targets.

items.text: Saquon Barkley OUT for Week 5 (hamstring) along with DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP all week; official final report.
items.implication: Eagles backfield to Shipley/Pierce; receiving corps thinned.
items.opportunity: Dallas Goedert full return boosts TE usage; RB handcuffs elevate.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT Week 5 (ankle); Tyler Huntley expected to start.
items.why: Left ankle; no practice; coach confirmed.
items.implication: Major QB downgrade; Ravens pass game and rush threat limited.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers still Q but optimistic; Likely/Andrews usage may shift.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty questionable (foot/ankle); Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby.
items.why: Foot and ankle; elevation of backup.
items.opportunity: If out, Hemby or committee work.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr has only 5 catches in 4 games and was not a real factor; expects Kendrick Bourne szn post-trade/inactive.
items.implication: Trade/inactive lessens fantasy pain; Wilson/Bourne upside.

items.text: Ridiculous/messy QUESTIONABLE list this week (Chase, Higgins, Jefferson, Addison, Jeanty, McConkey, Flowers, Stevenson, McLaurin, Kamara etc.); bracing for Sunday morning chaos.
items.why: Final Friday report; many key skill players.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries if any ruled out (e.g. Gesicki if CIN WRs sit).

items.text: Jayden Daniels, Chris Olave, Dallas Goedert, Jeremiyah Love listed IN/cleared for Week 5.
items.why: Full practice or no designation on final report.
items.opportunity: Normal roles restored; Goedert TE1 upside with Smith out.

items.text: Breece Hall, Stefon Diggs, Quentin Johnston, Michael Pittman among key OUTs.
items.implication: NYJ RB to backups; WAS WR thinned; LAC/IND pass games hit.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report (ankle maintenance); ETR projects him 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier with much bigger workload expected after Week 4 criticism.
items.why: Full-go comments; fan/media pressure on prior low usage; not listed.
items.implication: Strong RB start/DFS play vs DET; clear lead back.
items.conflict: Downside if ankle flares or committee persists.

items.text: Nabers multi-risk stack long-term (knee, shoulder, potential QB change to McCarthy, coaching boomer tendencies) despite great talent; not saying out this week.
items.why: Sore knee missed practice + prior frustration + stacked issues.
items.implication: Long-term caution; still viable short-term if healthy.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume including red zone vs soft defense.
Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + Bengals injury context + soft run D.
items.why: Volume + matchup + possible WR absences boosting checkdowns.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET (WR10), Christian Watson vs CHI (WR15), Isaiah Likely @ WSH (TE5) on volume/matchups.
items.why: Target volume/RZ + coverage mismatches; Wilson post-MHJ news.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison (WR41), Mark Andrews (TE17), Cam Skattebo (RB20), Tony Pollard (RB28), Jalen Hurts (QB15) on tough matchups/thin roles/efficiency/game script.
items.why: Matchups, usage data, banged-up supporting cast for Hurts.
items.implication: Sit or fade in favor of better spots.
